scope: ASMT-04 previewable PATH repair for shadowed commands after switching
status: implemented-and-isolated-ui-verified; no real user PATH was written
implementation: path_ownership::ReorderPlan binds the exact user PATH text, the managed entry and the shadowing directories
path_ownership::preview_reorder refuses non-absolute or padded inputs, an entry that is absent or appears more than once, and a conflict that is not actually ahead of the entry
Change::Reorder recomputes the plan from the live PATH before writing and rejects a stale plan
the reorder write is additionally checked so the multiset of PATH entries is identical before and after: it can only reorder, never add or remove
the journal records action=reorder and marks the record pending before writing and verified only after the read-back matches
commands::preview_path_repair resolves shadowed commands from the merged PATH, requires the managed entry to be present exactly once in the user PATH, and returns mode reorder/manual/none
manual mode lists the conflicting directory for the user to move by hand instead of inventing an ordering
the environments page shows a 预览 PATH 修复 action for the current environment, a read-only dialog with entry, conflicts and resulting PATH, and disables 调整顺序 when no plan is bound
applying reports that nothing was added or removed and that a new terminal is required

uiCoverage.release-052-ui: a shadowed LLVM switch degrades to 命令生效待确认; 预览 PATH 修复 opens a read-only dialog, asserts no apply call happened, asserts the bound entry is submitted, then a manual-mode preview keeps 调整顺序 disabled

notVerified: No real user PATH was reordered; every write test used a fixture store
No new terminal was opened to confirm the new resolution order
The UI path was exercised against a simulated backend only
limitations: Only ordering is repaired; installing a missing entry or deleting a stale installation remains a user action
System PATH entries are never reordered, so a shadow from the machine PATH still requires manual handling
When several managed entries are shadowed at once the preview reports manual mode rather than composing a multi-entry plan
